name: Expected Unexpectedness
description: Now and at the start of the next 2 stages, roll 3 dice. Gain various rewards based on their total.

name: Flexible
description: Gain 1 random Emblem. At the start of every Stage, gain a random Emblem. Your team gains Health for each Emblem they are holding.

name: Forged In Strength
description: Gain a random Artifact. When you drop below a Health threshold, gain more random Artifacts, a random completed item, and random components.

name: Giant and Mighty
description: Your team becomes large, gaining Health and maximum Health.

name: Golden Gamble
description: Gain gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain Completed Item anvils.

name: Golden Gamble+
description: Gain gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain Completed Item anvils.

name: Golden Gamble++
description: Gain gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain Completed Item anvils.

name: Hard Commit
description: Gain a random emblem. Now and at the start of each stage, gain a 1-star champion of that trait with a cost equal to the Stage (max 5) and 3 gold.

name: Heartsteel Circlet
description: Gain a Heartsteel Emblem, a Sparring Gloves, and a Yone.

name: Heartsteel Crown
description: Gain a Heartsteel Emblem, a Steadfast Heart, and a K'Sante.

name: Hedge Fund
description: Gain gold. Your maximum interest is increased to 10.

name: Hitmaker Circlet
description: Gain a Hitmaker Emblem, a B.F. Sword, and a Xayah.

name: Hitmaker Crown
description: Gain a Hitmaker Emblem, an Infinity Edge, and a Senna.

name: Hold the Line
description: Allies in your back 2 rows gain Ability Power and Attack Damage for each ally that starts combat in your front row.

name: Illbeats Circlet
description: Gain an Illbeats Emblem, a Tear Of The Goddess, and a Draven.

name: Illbeats Crown
description: Gain an Illbeats Emblem, a Gargoyle Stoneplate, and a Braum.

name: Invested+
description: Gain 26 gold. At the start of each round, gain 1 Shop reroll for every 10 gold above 50 (max 80 gold).

name: Invested++
description: Gain 45 gold. At the start of each round, gain 1 Shop reroll for every 10 gold above 50 (max 80 gold).

name: Investment Strategy II
description: Your champions gain permanent max health per interest you earn. Your maximum interest increases, and you gain gold now.

name: Ionic Spark Circlet
description: Gain an Ionic Spark Emblem, a Needlessly Large Rod, and an Aurora.

name: Ionic Spark Crown
description: Gain an Ionic Spark Emblem, an Ionic Spark, and an Annie.

name: Jazz Circlet
description: Gain a Jazz Emblem, a Recurve Bow, and a Bard.

name: Jazz Crown
description: Gain a Jazz Emblem, a Spear of Shojin, and a Lucian.

name: K/DA Circlet
description: Gain a K/DA Emblem, a Needlessly Large Rod, and a Leona.

name: K/DA Crown
description: Gain a K/DA Emblem, a Guinsoo's Rageblade, and a Kai'Sa.

name: Level Up!
description: Whenever you buy XP, gain additional XP, and gain XP immediately.

name: Living Forge
description: Gain an Artifact Anvil now, then again at recurring player-combat intervals.

name: Lucky Gloves
description: Thief's Gloves always give your champions ideal items. Gain Sparring Gloves and gold.

name: Lucky Gloves+
description: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain Sparring Gloves now, then gain another after a set number of player combats.

name: Luxury Subscription
description: Gain a package containing a champion and a 2-star champion, plus gold. At the start of each of the following stages, gain the package again.

name: Mad Science
description: Each ally randomly becomes either huge or tiny. Huge units gain max Health, Attack Damage, and Ability Power; tiny units gain Durability and Attack Speed.

name: Management Track
description: Gain a Manager Emblem. When champions gain bonuses from Manager, you have a chance to gain gold. After collecting gold from the Manager trait, gain a 2-star Dr. Mundo and Warmog's Armor.

name: Manager Circlet
description: Gain a Manager Emblem, a Chain Vest, and a Leona.

name: Min-Max
description: Gain a Golden Item Remover, 4 random components, and gold.

name: Money Monsoon
description: Gain gold now and every round for the rest of the game.

name: Nesting Anvils
description: Gain an Artifact Anvil. Open it to gain a Component Anvil, then open that to gain gold.

name: Nesting Anvils+
description: Gain an Artifact Anvil. After opening it, gain a Component Anvil. After opening that, gain gold.

name: One Buff Two Buff
description: Gain a Red Buff, a Blue Buff, and a Champion Duplicator.

name: Pain into Passion
description: On the A-Side, True Damage champions gain Attack Speed and Health for each Bling collected. On the B-Side, gain Gold after losing combat. Gain 3 True Damage champions.

name: Pandora's Box
description: Champions on your board permanently transform into random champions 1 cost tier higher (max 5). Then reforge all of your items, gain a random gold augment, and gain a random completed item.

name: Pandora's Items III
description: At the start of each round, items on your bench are randomized. Gain Radiant items.

name: Pentakill Circlet
description: Gain a Pentakill Emblem, a Negatron Cloak, and a Yorick.

name: Pentakill Crown
description: Gain a Pentakill Emblem, a Giant Slayer, and a Viego.

name: Prismatic Destiny
description: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and gold.

name: Prismatic Destiny+
description: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and gold.

name: Prismatic Ticket
description: Each time your shop is rerolled, you may gain a free reroll.

name: Radiant Rascal
description: Gain a Radiant Thief's Gloves item. This equips 2 random Radiant items every round.

name: Radiant Relics
description: Choose 1 of 5 Radiant Items. Gain a Magnetic Remover.

name: Renegade Circlet
description: Gain a Renegade Emblem, a Sparring Gloves, and an Aurora.

name: Renegade Crown
description: Gain a Renegade Emblem, a Hand of Justice, and a Qiyana.

name: Rock Circlet
description: Gain a Rock Emblem, a Needlessly Large Rod, and a Locke.

name: Rock Crown
description: Gain a Rock Emblem, a Hand Of Justice, and a Camille.

name: Royalties
description: Gain a Tactician’s Crown. Gain gold every round for the rest of the game.

name: Shimmerscale Essence
description: Gain a Gambler's Blade, then gain a Mogul's Mail after a set number of player combats.

name: Shopping Spree
description: When you level up, gain Shop refreshes based on your level. Gain gold.

name: Slayer Circlet
description: Gain a Slayer Emblem, a Chain Vest, and a Yone.

name: Slayer Crown
description: Gain a Slayer Emblem, a Titan's Resolve, and a Briar.

name: Soul Awakening
description: At combat start, your team gains Attack Damage and Ability Power each second. At max stacks, it deals bonus true damage.

name: Star of the Show
description: Gain a non-Tank champion and an Emblem for one of their traits. At a later stage, gain more copies of that champion.

name: Strange Duet III
description: Allies that start combat isolated in pairs gain Durability and Damage Amp.

name: Sweet Treats
description: Gain an Artifact anvil. Your team gains Health for each item equipped to a champion.

name: Swiftstriker Circlet
description: Gain a Swiftstriker Emblem, a Recurve Bow, and a Bard.

name: Swiftstriker Crown
description: Gain a Swiftstriker Emblem, a Hextech Gunblade, and a Bard.

name: Sword Overflow
description: Gain BF Swords. Your BF Swords grant Attack Speed.

name: Tactician's Kitchen
description: Gain a random Emblem. After a round-based delay, gain a Tactician's Cape.

name: The Golden Egg
description: Gain a golden egg that eventually hatches and grants a huge amount of loot. Winning player combat advances its hatch timer by one turn.

name: The Immortal Journey
description: Gain a Xayah, a Spear of Shojin, and gold.

name: The Trait Tree
description: Gain random Emblems and gold.

name: The Trait Tree+
description: Gain random Emblems, a Reforger, and gold.

name: Three Steps Ahead
description: For each of your next player-combat losses, gain a 5-cost champion and components.

name: TONS of Stats!
description: Your team gains Health, Attack Damage, Ability Power, Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Speed, and Mana.

name: Trait Ladder
description: Gain a random emblem. In a player combat, field non-unique traits to earn a reward; the trait requirement and reward size then increase.

name: True Damage Circlet
description: Gain a True Damage Emblem, a Giant's Belt, and an Ekko.

name: True Damage Crown
description: Gain a True Damage Emblem, an Infinity Edge, and a Senna.

name: Unearthed Treasure
description: After player combat, each unique Beach Pop champion empowered by a Beach Pop instrument has a chance to uncover some loot! Gain a Taric, a Zoe, and a Renekton.

name: Upward Mobility
description: Buying XP costs less. Gain Health and Shop rerolls whenever you level up.

name: Urf's Grab Bag
description: Gain Spatula, random components, and gold.

name: Verticality III
description: Champions gain Attack Damage, Ability Power, Armor, and Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

name: Wand Overflow
description: Gain Needlessly Large Rods. Your Needlessly Large Rods grant Attack Speed.

name: We Stick Together
description: Gain an Emblem for a random trait and a completed item anvil. Allies with that trait gain Attack Speed.

name: Worth the Wait II
description: Gain 2 copies of a random 2-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.
